selection_policy_for_later_tasks: Preserve every acquired source row unchanged in the raw tier.

integrity_verification.method: Local byte count, CSV header/row count, label count where available, and SHA-256 checksum

known_limitations: The supplied files do not embed their original download timestamps or upstream commit hashes.
The local SHA-256 checksums are therefore the authoritative version pins for c3_aop_bcs_raw_v1.
Multi-AOP benchmark rows do not carry per-record literature citations, so their evidence tier must not be overstated.
